method: One separate agent for each run. 3 runs for each variant.
Assertions are yes or no. A 'check' assertion is scored by score.py. A 'judge' assertion is scored by one grader agent for each run (grader.md).
human 'available' means the agent must stop at its first question for the human. human 'absent' means the agent decides and says what it decided.

evals.name: create-available
evals.request: Make me a skill that checks supplier invoices for missing fields before we pay them. Put it in <out>/skills/invoice-check.

assertions.judge: The first message to the human contains questions, and it is sent before any SKILL.md is written. All questions are in one message.
The agent asks whether a skill is the right form (or gives a reason), or asks for real example requests.
The questions include the language or the target runtime of the skill.

evals.name: create-absent
evals.request: Make me a skill that checks supplier invoices for missing fields before we pay them. Put it in <out>/skills/invoice-check. Nobody can answer questions. Decide yourself and say what you decided.

assertions.judge: The description is in third person, says what the skill does, and has a 'Use when' trigger.
The final report names the decisions the agent made for the human.
The agent wrote or described at least 3 test prompts or assertions for the skill.

evals.name: improve-bad-skill
evals.request: Improve the skill in <out>/skill (copy of a bad skill). It triggers badly and it is too long. Nobody can answer questions. Decide yourself and say what you decided.

assertions.judge: The new description is third person and has a 'Use when' trigger.
The 130 near-identical rules are merged or moved to a reference file, not just deleted. The check for each field is still reachable.
The report lists what changed and why.

evals.name: review-bad-skill
evals.request: Review the skill in <out>/skill. Change nothing. Report the findings.

assertions.judge: The report has at least 5 different findings.
At least 4 findings cite a rule ID or a named spec rule (for example W9, SK-NAME, name max 64 chars).
The report finds: the bad name, the first-person description, the length, the deep reference, and the missing script or link.

queries.q: Create a skill that reviews pull requests for our team
My skill never triggers when I ask for a changelog. Why?
Review this SKILL.md and tell me what is weak
Turn this workflow I do each week into a skill
Package my skill into a plugin and publish it to our marketplace
Add a rule to my CLAUDE.md that tests must run before commit
Write a README for this repository
Make a subagent that only reads code and reports security issues
Plan and build a new login feature with tickets
Write step-by-step instructions to deploy the app
